<<'EOF'\nimport csv\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nmeta = {}\nwith open('dataset/sensor_metadata.csv') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        if not row['sensor_id']: continue\n        meta[row['sensor_id']] = {\n            'subsystem': row['subsystem'],\n            'lo': float(row['normal_min']), 'hi': float(row['normal_max']),\n            'delay': int(row['response_delay_minutes']),\n        }\n\nreadings = defaultdict(list)\nfor fn in ['sensors_01.csv','sensors_02.csv','sensors_03.csv']:\n    with open(f'dataset/{fn}') as f:\n        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n            sid = row['sensor_id']\n            t = datetime.fromisoformat(row['timestamp']) - timedelta(hours=meta[sid]['offset'] if 'offset' in meta[sid] else 0)\n            readings[sid].append((t, float(row['value'])))\n\n# redo with offset properly\nmeta2 = {}\nwith open('dataset/sensor_metadata.csv') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        if not row['sensor_id']: continue\n        meta2[row['sensor_id']] = int(row['logger_utc_offset_hours'])\nreadings = defaultdict(list)\nfor fn in ['sensors_01.csv','sensors_02.csv','sensors_03.csv']:\n    with open(f'dataset/{fn}') as f:\n        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n            sid = row['sensor_id']\n            t = datetime.fromisoformat(row['timestamp']) - use median/MAD-ish robust stats)\nbase_end = datetime(2024,1,15,12,0)\nonsets = {}\nprint(f\"{'sensor':18s} {'subsys':12s} {'drift_obs':16s} {'drift_phys':16s} {'oor_phys':16s}\")\nfor sid, m in meta.items():\n    vals = readings[sid]\n    base = [v for t,v in vals if t < base_end]\n    mu = statistics.mean(base); sd = statistics.stdev(base)\n    # first time of sustained drift: 5 consecutive readings beyond 4 sigma, after 01-15 12:00\n    drift_t = None\n    consec = 0\n    for t,v in vals:\n        if t < base_end: continue\n        if abs(v-mu) > 4*sd:\n            consec += 1\n            if consec == 1: first = t\n            if consec >= 5:\n                drift_t = first; break\n        else:\n            consec = 0\n    # first sustained OOR (3+ consecutive), after 01-16 01:00 (skip decoys)\n    oor_t = None; consec=0\n    for t,v in vals:\n        if t < datetime(2024,1,16,1,0): continue\n        if v < m['lo'] or v > m['hi']:\n            consec += 1\n            if consec==1: firsto=t\n            if consec>=3: oor_t=firsto; break\n        else: consec=0\n    d = timedelta(minutes=m['delay'])\n    dp = (drift_t - d) if drift_t else None\n    op = (oor_t - d) if oor_t else None\n    onsets[sid] = (dp, op)\n    fmt = lambda x: x.strftime('%m-%d %H:%M') if x else 'None'\n    print(f\"{sid:18s} {m['subsystem']:12s} {fmt(drift_t):16s} {fmt(dp):16s} {fmt(op):16s}\")\n\nprint()\nsubsys_onset = {}\nfor sid,(dp,op) in onsets.items():\n    s = meta[sid]['subsystem']\n    for cand in (dp, op):\n        if cand and (s not in subsys_onset or cand < subsys_onset[s][0]):\n            subsys_onset[s] = (cand, sid)\nfor s,(t,sid) in sorted(subsys_onset.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0]):\n    print(f\"{s:12s} earliest physical onset: {t}  (via {sid})\")\nEOF","description":"Detect drift onset per sensor via baseline sigma test, correct for delays"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6837,"cache_read_input_tokens":26092,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6837,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"326b2105-2e8d-4ea3-b946-6c4aefeb9d92","uuid":"16e7d495-4997-4ae9-b006-888a56252be6","request_id":"req_011Ccs3DYcVkpj8utyngHRUT"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ccs3GnC9Kd98VpBP4WBHF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PNnFc5nHiqPW6kHhzG9Yxu","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport csv, statistics\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nmeta = {}\nwith open('dataset/sensor_metadata.csv') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        if not row['sensor_id']: continue\n        meta[row['sensor_id']] = {\n            'subsystem': row['subsystem'],\n            'delay': int(row['response_delay_minutes']),\n            'offset': int(row['logger_utc_offset_hours']),\n        }\n\nreadings = defaultdict(list)\nfor fn in ['sensors_01.csv','sensors_02.csv','sensors_03.csv']:\n    with open(f'dataset/{fn}') as f:\n        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n            sid = row['sensor_id']\n            t = datetime.fromisoformat(row['timestamp']) - timedelta(hours=meta[sid]['offset'])\n            readings[sid].append((t, float(row['value'])))\nfor sid in readings: readings[sid].sort()\n\n# Decoy windows to exclude (UTC)\ndecoys = {\n    'TURB_OUTPUT_01': (datetime(2024,1,15,17,50), datetime(2024,1,15,18,35)),\n    'STEAM_PRES_01': (datetime(2024,1,15,19,50), datetime(2024,1,15,20,30)),\n    'COOLING_PRES_01': (datetime(2024,1,16,0,0), datetime(2024,1,16,0,45)),\n}\n\nW0 = datetime(2024,1,15,20,45)\nW1 = datetime(2024,1,16,2,50)   # before turbine shutdown intervention\n\ndef fit_ramp(pts):\n    \"\"\"Fit flat(mu) for t<cp, mu + k*(t-cp) for t>=cp. Grid search cp, analytic k.\"\"\"\n    n = len(pts)\n    ts = [(p[0]-W0).total_seconds()/60 for p in pts]\n    vs = [p[1] for p in pts]\n    best = None\n    for ci in range(5, n-5):\n        cp = ts[ci]\n        pre = vs[:ci]\n        mu = sum(pre)/len(pre)\n        # least squares slope for post segment relative to mu\n        xs = [t-cp for t in ts[ci:]]\n        ys = [v-mu for v in vs[ci:]]\n        sxx = sum(x*x for x in xs)\n        k = sum(x*y for x,y in zip(xs,ys))/sxx if sxx>0 else 0\n        sse = sum((v-mu)**2 for v in pre) + sum((y-k*x)**2 for x,y in zip(xs,ys))\n        if best is None or sse < best[0]:\n            best = (sse, cp, mu, k)\n    sse, cp, mu, k = best\n    return W0 + timedelta(minutes=cp), k\n\nresults = defaultdict(list)\nprint(f\"{'sensor':18s} {'subsys':12s} {'ramp_obs (UTC)':17s} {'ramp_phys (UTC)':17s} slope/min\")\nfor sid, m in meta.items():\n    pts = [(t,v) for t,v in readings[sid] if W0 <= t <= W1]\n    if sid in decoys:\n        a,b = decoys[sid]\n        pts = [(t,v) for t,v in pts if not (a <= t <= b)]\n    cp, k = fit_ramp(pts)\n    phys = cp - timedelta(minutes=m['delay'])\n    results[m['subsystem']].append((phys, sid, k))\n    print(f\"{sid:18s} {m['subsystem']:12s} {cp.strftime('%H:%M'):17s} {phys.strftime('%H:%M'):17s} {k:+.4g}\")\n\nprint()\norder = []\nfor s, lst in results.items():\n    lst.sort()\n    order.append((lst[0][0], s, lst))\norder.sort()\nfor t, s, lst in order:\n    detail = ', '.join(f\"{sid.split('_',1)[1]}@{p.strftime('%H:%M')}\" for p,sid,_ in lst)\n    print(f\"{s:12s} earliest phys onset {t.strftime('%H:%M')}   [{detail}]\")\nEOF","description":"Fit flat-then-ramp changepoint per sensor on pre-intervention window"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5005,"cache_read_input_tokens":32929,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":5005,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"326b2105-2e8d-4ea3-b946-6c4aefeb9d92","uuid":"abb688c2-c614-4cfa-a41d-ee0321639515","request_id":"req_011Ccs3GmViw9bzoXiSot1T6"}

<<'EOF'\nimport csv, statistics\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nmeta = {}\nwith open('dataset/sensor_metadata.csv') as f:\n    for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n        if not row['sensor_id']: continue\n        meta[row['sensor_id']] = {'subsystem': row['subsystem'],\n            'delay': int(row['response_delay_minutes']),\n            'offset': int(row['logger_utc_offset_hours'])}\n\nreadings = defaultdict(list)\nfor fn in ['sensors_01.csv','sensors_02.csv','sensors_03.csv']:\n    with open(f'dataset/{fn}') as f:\n        for row in csv.DictReader(f):\n            sid = row['sensor_id']\n            t = datetime.fromisoformat(row['timestamp']) - timedelta(hours=meta[sid]['offset'])\n            readings[sid].append((t, float(row['value'])))\nfor sid in readings: readings[sid].sort()\n\nsensors = ['CORE_EXIT_01','CORE_FUEL_01','CORE_FLUX_01','PRIMARY_TEMP_01','PRIMARY_PRES_01',\n           'STEAM_DELTA_01','STEAM_TEMP_01','COOLING_TEMP_01','COOLING_HEAT_01','TURB_BEAR_01','TURB_SPEED_01']\n\n# baseline stats from 01-15 00:00-18:00\nb0,b1 = datetime(2024,1,15,0,0), datetime(2024,1,15,18,0)\nstats = {}\nfor sid in sensors:\n    base = [v for t,v in readings[sid] if b0<=t<b1]\n    stats[sid] = (statistics.mean(base), statistics.stdev(base))\n\n# 15-min block mean z-scores from 20:00 to 02:45\nstart = datetime(2024,1,15,20,0)\nblocks = [start + timedelta(minutes=15*i) for i in range(28)]\nhdr = 'block_UTC   ' + ' '.join(f\"{s.replace('_01','')[:9]:>9s}\" for s in sensors)\nprint(hdr)\nfor bstart in blocks:\n    bend = bstart + timedelta(minutes=15)\n    row = [f\"{bstart.strftime('%d %H:%M')}\"]\n    for sid in sensors:\n        vals = [v for t,v in readings[sid] if bstart<=t<bend]\n        mu,sd = stats[sid]\n        z = (statistics.mean(vals)-mu)/sd if vals else float('nan')\n        row.append(f\"{z:>9.1f}\")\n    print(' '.join(row))\nEOF","description":"Show 15-min block mean z-scores per sensor around cascade onset"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4499,"cache_read_input_tokens":37934,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4499,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"326b2105-2e8d-4ea3-b946-6c4aefeb9d92","uuid":"c10f9eb3-0dda-4bda-880b-ece019f14e00","request_id":"req_011Ccs3LA3dUpPCgG5qR85RX"}

d\n            else: c=0\n        return None\n    z1,z2 = first_cross(2), first_cross(3)\n    results[m['subsystem']].append((cp_phys, sid, z1, z2))\n    fmt=lambda x: x.strftime('%H:%M') if x else ' -- '\n    print(f\"{sid:18s} {m['subsystem']:12s} {cp_obs.strftime('%H:%M'):7s} {cp_phys.strftime('%H:%M'):7s} {fmt(z1):8s} {fmt(z2):8s} {k/sd:+.3f}\")\n\nprint()\nfor s,lst in sorted(results.items(), key=lambda kv: min(x[0] for x in kv[1])):\n    lst.sort()\n    print(f\"{s:12s} cp onsets: \" + '  '.join(f\"{sid.split('_',1)[1].replace('_01',''):5s}{p.strftime('%H:%M')}\" for p,sid,_,_ in lst))\nEOF","description":"Changepoint fit on diurnal-corrected residuals with delay correction"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":131,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3764,"cache_read_input_tokens":46608,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3764,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"326b2105-2e8d-4ea3-b946-6c4aefeb9d92","uuid":"9e7f3a9c-bda6-4c3f-9915-8b823c4e8216","request_id":"req_011Ccs3RCQeMwj3JQ4wuCy1v"}
